# lsb-cpp-style

C++ style rules for LandSandBoat server code. Use when writing, modifying, or reviewing C++ (.cpp, .h, .hpp) in LandSandBoat/server. Covers comments, const/auto/constexpr usage, variable scope, control flow, ternaries and IILEs, push-ifs-up-fors-down, rule of zero/five, ownership and smart pointers, explicit/override/noexcept, and modern standard library preferences.

See [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) for the full instructions, and the [repo README](../../README.md) for how skills are installed.
